title: 第15章 金惜狂之死唐山背大锅第16章 天骄大会
lines: “收场了。”顾云淡淡一笑。
舞月婵的瞳孔却是缩小到了极点，几乎难以置信的看着眼前发生的一幕。
自己的山哥……将那个金惜狂给杀了？
而且还是头颅炸开？这么惨烈的死法？
可那人是白云帝国的皇子啊！！
她的心中担忧不已，糟了，山哥一定会遭到白云帝国的追杀的！
场中更是接连不断响起惊呼声。
“快！快来人！”
“该死的，竟然敢在白云城内杀白云帝国皇子，简直是无法无天！禁卫军何在？！”
客栈瞬间乱作了一团。
“喵、喵喵！”舞月婵心急如焚，就想要从顾云坏里面钻出去，但是被顾云一把按住，无法动弹。
返回了客房之中。
金惜狂是谁杀的？
那当然是顾云。
唐山的那根金丝不过是麻痹效果而已，在原着中，这个金惜狂甚至还会因为此次战斗而对唐山心生敬佩，从而后续两人交好，唐山还帮助对方夺得了白云帝国的皇位。
到后期，甚至飞升上界，加入了讨伐顾家的联军。
顾云还记得自己一个有名有姓的族姐就是死在了这家伙的手里。
该死的还是得死！
现在一举两得，既防患于未然，又让剧情彻底崩坏了。
这个天命之子唐山在白云帝国境内，将会成为彻底人人喊打的存在。
【叮！宿主设计害死金惜狂，导致唐山被白云帝国通缉，损失一大助力。唐山天命值减少100点，大罗道塔第一层解锁进度（7202000）】
才减少一百点？
顾云心中不喜，这个天命之子真抠门，想着，他的目光又落在了舞月婵的身上。
这个女主可是对对方极为重要，若是自己能够拿下的话。
只不过现在使用了原形毕露卡，舞月婵需要七日才能重新幻化成人。
不过身为猫妖的形态，顾云可以拿她做很多事情。
明日，就是天骄大战开始的日子。
若是在天骄大战上出现，唐山就能继续苟活一段时间，若是他能够夺得冠军，更是有可能受到某方势力的青睐，从而让白云帝国投鼠忌器。
可以说，这绝对是对方能够想到的唯一的破局之法。
另外一边。
唐山好不容易带着“舞月婵”跑到了一处偏僻之地。
“呼——呼——小舞，总算没事了。”
content_en:
"It's over." Gu Yun smiled lightly.
Wu Yuechan's pupils shrank to the extreme, and she looked at the scene happening in front of her in disbelief.
My own Brother Shan...killed that Jin Xikuang?
And his head exploded? Such a tragic death?
But that man is the prince of the Baiyun Empire! !
She was worried in her heart, no matter what, Brother Shan would definitely be hunted down by the Baiyun Empire!
There were even more exclamations in the field.
"Ahhhhhhh!!!!!!"
"Quick! Someone come quickly!"
"Damn it, you dare to kill the prince of the Baiyun Empire in Baiyun City. It's simply lawless! Where are the Imperial Guards?!"
The inn was instantly in chaos.
"Meow, meow meow!" Wu Yuechan was so anxious that she wanted to get out of Gu Yunbao, but she was held down by Gu Yun and could not move.
Returned to the guest room.
Who killed Jin Xikuang?
That was of course Gu Yun.
Tangshan's golden thread was just a paralysis effect. In the original work, Jin Xikuang even admired Tangshan because of this battle, and the two subsequently became friends, and Tangshan also helped the other party win the throne of the Baiyun Empire.
In the later stage, he even ascended to the upper world and joined the coalition forces to conquer the Gu family.
Gu Yun still remembered that a famous clan sister of his died in the hands of this guy.
Damn it or die!
Now he kills two birds with one stone, not only preventing problems before they happen, but also completely ruining the plot.
Tangshan, the son of destiny, will become an existence that everyone will fight against in the Baiyun Empire.
【bite! The host designed to kill Jin Xikuang, causing Tangshan to be wanted by the Baiyun Empire and losing a lot of help. Tangshan’s destiny value is reduced by 100 points, and the unlocking progress of the first level of Daluo Tao Tower (7202000)]
Only a hundred points less?
Gu Yun was unhappy. This son of destiny was really stingy. Thinking about it, his eyes fell on Wu Yuechan again.
This heroine is extremely important to the other party, if she can win it.
But now that she is using her original form of Biluka, Wuyuechan needs seven days to transform into a human again.
But as a cat demon, Gu Yun can do many things with her.
Tomorrow is the day when the war between geniuses begins.
If he appears in the Tianjiao War, Tangshan can continue to survive for a while. If he can win the championship, he may be favored by a certain force, thus making the Baiyun Empire take advantage of it.
It can be said that this is definitely the only way the other party can think of to break the situation.
The other side.
Tangshan finally took "Wu Yue Chan" to a remote place.
"Huh-huh-Xiao Wu, it's finally okay."
title_en: Chapter 15 Jin Xikuang’s death, Tangshan takes the blame Chapter 16 Genius Conference
